closing_authority: The design organisation with the platform installer and the competent authority. The category of a section is a joint decision with the platform, because the category encodes the installation zone the platform owns.

zones.name: Unpressurised fuselage interior, protection assembly and mission system panel

sections.title: Temperature and Altitude
sections.article: payload and kit first article, installed on the platform
sections.limitation: The ground survival and operating temperatures of the kit itself are not declared: only the payload envelope is, and the kit carries no powered item except the protection assembly.

sections.title: Temperature Variation
sections.article: payload and kit first article
sections.limitation: No thermal model of the installation exists in this study.
sections.open_on: the temperature ramp rate of the two zones

sections.title: Humidity
sections.article: kit first article, with the interface plate and the harnesses installed
sections.limitation: The sealing and drainage provisions are designed but not validated against a severity level.
sections.open_on: the severity, which needs the platform compartment definition and the drainge and sealing assumptions confirmed

sections.title: Operational Shock
sections.article: kit first article with a mass-representative payload
sections.limitation: A representative payload mass is used in place of the real payload.

sections.title: Crash Safety
sections.limitation: The structural analysis is quasi-static and the crash case rests on declared platform factors rather than on a clause of 27.561 for a belly installation.

sections.title: Vibration
sections.article: kit first article with the payload, before and after the endurance exposure
sections.limitation: The resonance separation is not demonstrated (VER011): the single degree of freedom estimate lands inside the rotor bands, and neither the test above nor the analysis can close that until the modes are measured.

sections.title: Explosive Atmosphere
sections.limitation: The non-applicability rests on the platform confirming that no fuel vent or tank zone reaches the installation.

sections.title: Waterproofness
sections.article: kit first article, installed, including the connectors and the harness entries
sections.limitation: The washing procedure and frequency come from the operator and are not declared.

sections.title: Fluids Susceptibility
sections.article: kit first article with a representative payload interface
sections.limitation: The fluid list of the platform is not declared, so the test fluids cannot be fixed: the plan names the families and the platform has to select them.

sections.title: Sand and Dust
sections.article: kit first article, with the payload envelope closed and with it removed
sections.limitation: The declared operating environment of the platform does not fix whether unimproved surfaces are used.

sections.title: Fungus
sections.limitation: Seals, grommets, marking materials, cable jackets and sealants are not selected yet, so the assessment covers the declared structural materials only and has to be repeated when the non-metallic items are chosen.

sections.title: Salt Fog
sections.article: kit first article after the corrosion protection is applied
sections.limitation: The exposure duration is a platform environmental requirement, not declared here.

sections.title: Magnetic Effect
sections.limitation: The harness route is declared in the layout, but the platform magnetic survey is not available.
sections.open_on: the platform positions of the compass and magnetometer relative to the harness route

sections.title: Power Input
sections.article: protective assembly and payload first article
sections.limitation: The platform generating system is not declared, so the choice of Z covers the cases instead of being argued from the platform data.

sections.title: Voltage Spike
sections.article: protective assembly and payload first article
sections.limitation: The platform bus transient data is not declared.

sections.title: Audio Frequency Conducted Susceptibility
sections.article: protective assembly and payload first article
sections.limitation: The category is not independent, so it stays open until section 16 is confirmed by the platform.

sections.title: Induced Signal Susceptibility
sections.article: data harness and payload first article
sections.limitation: The platform wiring standard and the receiver sensitivity are not declared.

sections.title: Radio Frequency Susceptibility
sections.article: payload and kit first article, with the harnesses installed
sections.limitation: The HIRF environment is in the platform protection plan, which the study references without holding.

sections.title: Emission of Radio Frequency Energy
sections.article: payload and kit first article, powered from a representative bus
sections.limitation: The payload emissions are not characterised in this study.
sections.open_on: the platform radio compatibility limits: SYS016 requires them and the platform interface data does not declare them

sections.title: Lightning Induced Transient Susceptibility
sections.article: harnesses and payload first article
sections.limitation: The platform lightning environment and the induced transient levels are not declared.

sections.title: Lightning Direct Effects
sections.article: kit first article with the payload optical aperture
sections.limitation: The test is destructive on the article and is planned with the platform zoning.
sections.open_on: the lightning attachment zone of the belly position, which the platform has to declare

sections.title: Icing
sections.article: kit first article with a representative payload envelope
sections.limitation: No ice accretion analysis of the installation exists.
sections.open_on: the icing environment the platform is approved for

sections.title: Electrostatic Discharge
sections.article: payload connector and kit first article
sections.limitation: The bonding means are declared but the static path is not measured.

sections.title: Fire and Flammability
sections.article: harness sections and protection assembly
sections.limitation: The flammability ratings of the cable jackets and the protection assembly materials are not declared.
